maya_research: Noticing a regression after int8 tokenizer merge + quant pipeline tweak. Long-context QA and summarization holdouts show increased hallucination. Suspect normalization change plus shingle-based dedupe mismatch.

maya_research: Example failing ids: 605201,605233,605299. Baseline (q7b-fp16) OK, q7b-int8 drifts on multi-paragraph sections.

ash_labelops: Can you share the ingest normalization diff? We recently flipped `collapse_whitespace=True` and switched unicode normalize to NFKC in sampling. That will change fingerprints.

maya_research: Diff: `normalize_unicode: NFC->NFKC, collapse_ws: False->True`. Also tokenizer merges updated for int8 build. I ran `tools/token_fingerprint.py --id 605201 --before snap_202510 --after live` and got different rolling shingle hashes.

jon_sre: ci-bot ran the canary deploy: q7b-int8 reached 10% in staging yesterday, no infra errors but tail lat increased. Recommend routing rule: requests.len>1200 -> q7b-fp16 until we triage.

ci-bot: [system] Deployed q7b-int8 to staging at 2025-10-28T08:14:22Z; canary 1%->10%. Telemetry: increased dedupe-leak metric and embedding-variance spike.

ash_labelops: Plan: 1) compute pre-tokenization checksum (sha256 of normalized text) on affected holdout subset to detect leaked gold 2) run a 300-item micro-golden focusing on longsumm/support 3) exclude fingerprints that match existing gold to avoid relabelling leaked items.

maya_research: SQL used to pull candidates:
```
SELECT id, tag, length_chars, fingerprint FROM promptset
WHERE tag IN ('longsumm','support-thread')
AND created_at >= '2025-09-15'
AND length_chars > 800
ORDER BY length_chars DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

ash_labelops: I'll run the fingerprint diff job tonight: `jobs/fingerprint_diff.py --snapshot snap_202510 --current live --out /tmp/fp_delta.csv` and post the top 300 novel fingerprints. ETA: start 22:00 UTC, finish ~2h.

maya_research: Also running an A/B on a stratified 1k holdout: `python eval/ab_compare.py --models q7b-fp16,q7b-int8 --holdout strat1k.json --metrics rouge,halluc_rate,perplexity` will share results. If halluc_rate delta >0.03 we gate rollout.

jon_sre: I'll add the routing flag as a feature toggle so ops can flip quickly. Also adding telemetry tag `fp_leak_detected` on requests that match old gold fingerprints for auditing.

nash_labelops: Reminder: before starting micro-golden we must run whitespace normalization on the holdout with both old and new settings to compute canonical fingerprints. That avoids unnecessary labeling. Use helper: `normalize_text(text, nfkc=True, collapse_ws=True)` vs `normalize_text(text, nfkc=False, collapse_ws=False)`.

maya_research: Good call. If dedupe leakage is confirmed we'll need to rebuild the micro-holdout excluding leaked gold and re-run A/B. Also flagging for model team: token merge table differences may require vocab alignment for shared tasks.

liz_prod: For visibility, I'll open ticket PROD-ML-512 with failing ids and the proposed rollback/routing plan. Keep me posted when the micro-gold job link is live.

nash_labelops: Ack. Posting job link here when started and pinging labelers specialized in longform summaries.

maya_research: Thanks team. Priority actions: (1) @nash_labelops run fingerprint diff & start 300 micro-gold (2) @maya_research run 1k A/B and upload metrics (3) @jon_sre add len>1200 routing toggle and telemetry. We'll reconvene in this thread with early metrics.
